description: The send button of the chat card that chat_with_agent opens: the card calls this with the message the user typed and the conversation so far, and shows the agent's reply in the card. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant; a single answer for the assistant comes from ask_agent. Each agent answers a limited number of card messages a day.

history.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.

message.description: The new message, up to 1500 characters.

name: send_agent_message
title: Send a chat card message
